snippet.title: Doodle, please! - Meet this little guy
snippet.description:
Meet the little stick figure who needs a bridge to reach the green flag. Draw him one on the graph paper. Close the loop and your sketch becomes a stone. Drop it on the far end of a lever and see what happens.

I made Doodle, Please! for iPhone. The current version has 120 puzzles across six hand-drawn islands. The first six puzzles are free, and one optional purchase unlocks the other 114.

Open the links on my channel profile and tap “Doodle, Please! on iPhone” to find the game on the App Store.
You can also search “Doodle, Please! - Draw Physics” in the App Store.
https://apps.apple.com/app/id6818445476
